label: Updated 12 PM ET
title: Today In Golf
summary: A 30-second briefing on today’s biggest golf stories.

items.headline: CJ CUP Byron Nelson
items.text: Si Woo Kim leads THE CJ CUP Byron Nelson at 20-under through seven holes, three shots ahead of Tom Hoge and four clear of a trio including Wyndham Clark and Sungjae Im.

items.headline: Kim hopes to play with Scheffler
items.text: Si Woo Kim said he wants to play alongside Scottie Scheffler in the final group to intensify the competition after their good conversations in early rounds.

items.headline: Birdie fest expected Saturday
items.text: The $25 million renovation at TPC Craig Ranch led to lower scores Friday, with preferred lies and weather delays setting up another move-packed third round Saturday.
